# Map of the platform

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_map.py. Do not edit by hand: run `uv run --project platform python scripts/gen_map.py` from the repository root. -->

Generated at commit `7fc984e` · projection version `55` · 37 stage modules · 160 event types · 161 index tables · 138 service modules · 134 MCP tools · 237 CLI commands · 21 skills.

Read [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md) first. This file answers *where*: for each stage module, the events, models, index files, tables, task kinds, gates and checks it owns, and the services that name its events; then every MCP tool, CLI command, service and skill with what it reaches. Links are found by name (see the script's docstring), so a missing link means the code does not name the thing, not that no relation exists. Paths are relative to `platform/src/factory/` unless they start with `plugin/`.

## CLI commands

Defined in `cli/main.py` (typer); rendering in `cli/render.py` and siblings.

| Command | Services | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `factory audit label` | `audit` | A human's label on one sampled work. |
| `factory audit report` | `audit` | The latest audit's labelled count, false-exclusion rate and implicated criteria. |
| `factory audit sample` | `agreement`, `audit`, `evidence`, `search` | Draw the audit sample of the agreed works; each work with its agreed verdict and title. |
| `factory benchmark-ledger` | `benchmark_ledger` | Reported against reproduced values and own results, beside the evidence report (which never contains them). |
| `factory briefing` | `briefing`, `views` | The project briefing, complete (the researcher's variant): a reading path for a person joining mid-way. |
| `factory calibrate draw` | `calibration`, `evidence` | Draw the calibration set once; a later draw returns the same set. |
| `factory calibrate label` | `calibration` | A human's label on one work of the calibration set. |
| `factory cards assert` | `cards` | Record a property you state yourself (a `researcher` basis assertion, `stated`). |
| `factory cards confirm` | `cards` | Confirm an inferred (or imported-unverified) assertion. |
| `factory cards list` | `cards` | Method cards and problem descriptions, with their live assertion counts. |
| `factory cards reject` | `cards` | Reject an assertion; it stays in the log and leaves the default views. |
| `factory cards show` | `cards` | A card with its assertions; stale ones are shown and labelled with why. |
| `factory check` | `check` | List the project's gaps, with ids; exit 1 when any is an error (the human view). |
| `factory commit` | `commit` | Commit the new event and text-blob files of the projects hosted here. |
| `factory concept-links confirm` | `concepts` | Confirm an inferred `uses` link. |
| `factory concept-links list` | `concepts` | `uses` links, labelled; the default shows stated and confirmed ones. |
| `factory concept-links reject` | `concepts` | Reject a `uses` link; it stays in the log and leaves the views. |
| `factory concepts approve` | `concepts` | Approve a concept's source; the concept then shows, labelled unreviewed. |
| `factory concepts define` | `concepts` | Define a concept as the human; with --approve its source is approved too. |
| `factory concepts history` | `concepts` | Every step of a concept: definitions, source decisions and reviews. |
| `factory concepts list` | `concepts` | Concepts with an approved source, labelled; the others are counted. |
| `factory concepts merge` | `concepts` | Merge two names of one concept; reversible with `concepts unmerge`. |
| `factory concepts reject-source` | `concepts` | Reject a concept's source (a note is required). |
| `factory concepts review` | `concepts` | Review a concept's live definition as the human; a wrong verdict needs a note. |
| `factory concepts show` | `concepts` | One concept: name, text, source, quotes, writer and flags. |
| `factory concepts source` | `concepts` | Give a concept a new source (a redefinition by the human) and approve it. |
| `factory concepts unmerge` | `concepts` | Undo a merge. |
| `factory conclusions diff` | `conclusions` | Computed state of each active conclusion against a snapshot (no statements). |
| `factory conclusions register` | `conclusions` | Register a conclusion with its basis (human act); every basis reference must resolve. |
| `factory conclusions retire` | `conclusions` | Withdraw a conclusion from evaluation (human act); the registration stays in the log. |
| `factory conclusions status` | `conclusions` | Each active conclusion with your statement and its computed state since the last snapshot. |
| `factory consolidation complete` | `consolidation` | Complete a pass whose every cluster is decided; the due counts start again. |
| `factory consolidation decide` | `consolidation` | Decide one cluster as the researcher; a merge is recorded with its decision. |
| `factory consolidation list` | `consolidation` | The clusters of a pass with their decisions and proposals. |
| `factory consolidation start` | `consolidation` | Compute the candidate clusters and open a pass (one task per cluster). |
| `factory consolidation status` | `consolidation` | Whether consolidation is due, and the open pass if any. |
| `factory contradictions confirm` | `finders` | Confirm a proposed contradiction (a human act, not from the proposing session). |
| `factory contradictions list` | `finders` | Claim contradictions; the default shows the confirmed ones. |
| `factory contradictions reject` | `finders` | Reject a proposed contradiction; it stays in the log. |
| `factory contributions agreement` | `contributions` | The agreement of the two contribution passes and the unresolved disagreements. |
